name: Bog Wraith
description: Wraith of Dominaria; one was summoned by Aldon's dark amulet and became his advisor.

timeline.summary: Aldon summons a vampire, a frozen shade and a Bog Wraith with a dark amulet; with the wraith he attacks Dreygar to reclaim his castle.
timeline.quote: a Bog Wraith was summoned along with a vampire and a frozen shade by Aldon 's use of a dark amulet

citation.text: "Wraith", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dreygar is killed and the Bog Wraith remains an advisor to Aldon.
timeline.quote: When Dreygar was killed, the bog wraith remained an advisor to Aldon.
